commit.message: feat(runtime): commit exact self-mod evidence atomically

intent: Add one canonical RuntimeState writer for self_mod_gate and self_mod_promote attestations. It must bind an exact already-durable ExecutionIdentity, use one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, persist one deterministic receipt plus one completed idempotency record, replay only byte/semantic-exact evidence, reject partial or conflicting state, and reserve the two logical slots from every generic async, sync, legacy, combined-event, and idempotency writer. The resulting RuntimeReceipt is evidence only: it attests a decision and is never a bearer authorization for repository effects.

negative_controls.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_runtime_state_self_mod_exact.py -k "generic_writer or combined_event or generic_idempotency"
negative_controls.name: reserved-slots-reject-generic-writers

negative_controls.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_runtime_state_self_mod_exact.py -k "missing_identity or nonexact_identity or conflicting_replay or partial_state or stale_state or rollback"
negative_controls.name: invalid-or-torn-evidence-fails-closed

honest_blockers: This packet persists exact gate/promote attestations only. It does not launch a semantic producer, run Foundry, create an independent Vibe Halt receipt, authorize or apply a repository effect, transition a Mission Control task, or claim an end-to-end run.
RuntimeReceipt remains an evidence record, not a nominal capability. A later effect evaluator must require separate sealed authority and cannot accept this row as bearer authorization.
PR 1466 and this packet require approval before merge. Passing local or CI gates does not satisfy that external human gate.
Three SADHANA worktrees carry older divergent committed RuntimeState lineages; they are a future rebase risk but have no present uncommitted collision with this packet.
interface_mismatches: The existing self-mod helper and generic receipt writers use INSERT OR REPLACE and cannot distinguish exact replay from conflicting replacement.
The existing generic idempotency begin/complete path spans multiple transactions and can leave started, partial, or auxiliary receipt state; the exact gate/promote writer must not compose it.

The current schema has no uniqueness constraint on logical side_effect_key, so the exact writer must detect deterministic receipt-id, logical-slot, and cross-idempotency-key collisions inside its owned transaction.
Open draft PR 1060 fences self_mod_apply with fail-open ledger behavior; this packet reserves only gate/promote and deliberately does not inherit that authority doctrine.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the P1 commit as one unit. This restores legacy gate/promote writers and removes the atomic exact API; no runtime service, task lifecycle, provider, repository effect, deployment, or external system is changed by this packet.
